name: boto3
description: A lightweight Python library for interacting with AWS services.
rationale: Boto3 is a local-first alternative to AWS SDKs, providing a simple and efficient way to manage AWS resources. Building this tool now allows developers to focus on their core tasks without worrying about setting up an entire AWS infrastructure.
test_criteria: All unit tests must pass (pytest exit 0)
No hardcoded secrets or credentials in source
